SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.TARGET AS BUYER , A.KEY_1 AS PO_NO , A.KEY_2 AS PO_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND A.TARGET = 'KRWOOS0062' AND A.KEY_9 = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PODT.PLANT , PODT.PO_NO , PODT.PO_SEQ , PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , PODT.DS_DATE , PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION , PODT.RD_DATE , PODT.ITEM_QTY , PODT.DO_QTY , PODT.IV_QTY , PODT.DI_QTY , PODT.GR_QTY , PODT.STATUS FROM ICOMPODT PODT INNER JOIN ICOMPOHD POHD ON (1 = 1 AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO ) WHERE PODT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PODT.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PODT.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND A.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND A.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
